title: Supervisor, Commercial Operations
description:
Company Overview:
  
  
Flowserve is a global manufacturer of pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services, delivering comprehensive flow control solutions that support essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. If you're looking for a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, Flowserve offers the opportunity to put your experience in motion. Whether you're an individual contributor or a people leader, you'll find meaningful opportunities for professional growth, competitive rewards, and a workplace grounded in our core values: People, Safety, Integrity, Ownership and Ingenuity. At Flowserve, we're inspired by what we can achieve together—creating extraordinary flow control solutions that strengthen today's world while building tomorrow.
  
  
**Role Summary:**
The role of the Supervisor is to be a player / coach. This includes driving the responsiveness of their assigned Commercial Operations team to enable us to increase bookings overall. While maintaining responsibility for some quoting activity, this position will be responsible for building a highly responsive and customer driven group. The group will be focused on providing our Flowserve sales organization, customers, distributors, and 3rd party representative channel partners with the most technically sound and competitive quotation solutions for all pertinent inquiries in addition to transferring complete and correct order files for execution to our operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Requirements:**

* For pre-defined accounts, the Supervisor will be responsible for the review of RFQs and the issuance of quotes for the products that this person supports.
* Drive timely responsiveness to all viable quotation opportunities. This includes tracking the response time of the Commercial Operations team based on agreed upon standards.
* Manage the review of all valve and actuation orders for completeness and correctness and assist in resolving any issues to ensure proper order entry.
* Proper order entry to include clean Order Transfer files that are provided to Order Management in the agreed upon time frame.
* Coordinate and approve commercial terms of purchase orders and/or contracts including SAP generation and approval along with the resolution of any respective terms and conditions issues, based on Flowserve guidelines.
* Implement and oversee a continual training program to insure.
* Team members are properly applying their technical expertise and commercial knowledge during quotation preparation.
* Are updated on our techniques for utilizing any of the respective configurators / sizing and selection tools required for proposal generation.
* Are learning to apply our best practices in sizing, selecting and quoting the best suited Flowserve FPD products.
* Ensure applicable industry standards are applied correctly.
* Any schools conducted at the operation are well coordinated, informative and beneficial to all attendees (Flowserve direct or 3rd party sales personnel).
* Team Members are being developed to continuously enhance and improve performance.
* Work closely and develop strong business relationships with the key members of our operations, sales and engineering management teams to help drive the success of our FPD organization.
* Continually analyze and track the results of our pricing and quotation practices including the generation of win / loss quotation hit rates to enhance our effectiveness.
* Track, monitor, and review the performance of your individual direct reports through our performance management review process including assigning measurable goals and focused accountabilities. Monitor the progress for each team member throughout the year per our HR guidelines and processes.
* Work closely with our outside sales organization to enhance our communication, project pursuit, collaboration, and overall selling efforts.
* Comply with Flowserve goals, objectives and policies and manage your respective team members to adhere to the same standards.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Successful inside / outside sales experience.
* Knowledge and experience serving the variety of process control markets associated with the assigned products and / or region.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Detailed oriented.
* Proven track records of completing assignments as requested and in a timely manner.

* Computer skills including Microsoft Office, Internet along with the ability and willingness to learn how to use other or new business software packages as required by the role.

* Coordinate collection and verification of KYC, income and other required documents.
* Ensure applications are processed accurately and within defined turnaround times.
* Coordinate with credit, operations, legal and documentation teams.

* Conduct preliminary assessment of customer applications.
* Review customer financial information, repayment capacity and credit history.
* Identify potential credit risks and escalate cases requiring detailed assessment.
* Coordinate with the credit/risk team for final underwriting and approval.
* Ensure lending decisions are supported by complete and accurate documentation.

**4. Customer & Partner Management**

* Understand customer financial requirements and recommend appropriate credit solutions.
* Manage channel partners and referral sources.
* Ensure transparent communication regarding eligibility, documentation, pricing, repayment and other terms.
* Handle customer queries and coordinate resolution of service issues.

**5. Disbursement & Operations**

* Coordinate approved cases through documentation and disbursement.
* Ensure all pre-disbursement requirements are completed.
* Track applications at every stage and minimise processing delays.
* Maintain accurate records of applications, approvals, rejections and disbursements.

**6. Portfolio Monitoring & Collections Coordination**

* Monitor the performance of the credit portfolio.
* Track repayment status and overdue accounts.
* Coordinate with the collections team on delinquent accounts.
* Identify early warning indicators and escalate potential portfolio risks.
* Support initiatives to improve repayment performance and reduce delinquency.

**7. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly credit business reports.
* Track:
* Applications received
* Applications processed
* Approvals
* Rejections
* Disbursements
* Disbursement value
* Turnaround time
* Overdue accounts
* Portfolio performance
* Provide management with regular updates and insights.

* Ensure all credit activities follow Vanmoh’s internal policies and approval processes.
* Maintain proper KYC and documentation standards.
* Ensure customer data and financial information are handled confidentially.
* Follow applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Identify gaps in the credit process and recommend improvements.

**9. Team Management**

* Manage and mentor credit/operations executives where applicable.
* Allocate applications and responsibilities across the team.
* Set team-level targets and KPIs.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide training.
* Build a disciplined, customer-focused credit operations team.

Portfolio quality

Customer retention

Compliance adherence

Team productivity
